steps.title: Discovery from the client's own documents
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: from the documents in jobs/{{job_id}}/sources only, list the {{role}} tasks the AI Employee will take, what it must never do, and the questions for the client.

steps.title: The client's LLM wiki
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: build the client's wiki in ICM folders (every folder passes the walk test) from jobs/{{job_id}}/sources, with citations back to each source file.

steps.title: Instinct front-desk persona
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: write the client-facing Instinct persona for a {{role}}: voice, what it answers from the wiki, and when it hands off to a human.

steps.title: Crew under Instinct
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: configure the firstmate-style crew (one supervisor, visible crewmates, worktrees; Relay off, tmux backend) for the {{role}} tasks, each with a green/yellow/red tier.

steps.title: WhatsApp Business Cloud API setup guide
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: write the setup guide for the client's OWN WhatsApp Business Cloud API account and number (we never hold their credentials).

steps.title: Rehearsal judged by a different model family
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: run 20 rehearsal conversations against the wiki and persona; report wrong answers, made-up facts and missed hand-offs.

steps.title: Connect the client's WhatsApp number
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: the client connects their own number.

steps.title: Pricing and contract
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: pricing and the contract are the captain's.
